label: 3.42ct G VS1 — contrasting preferences, limited evidence
commentary: Compared with the 4.10ct H in the shared supplier-video album (#13), Inked personally preferred this G while stressing their non-expert perspective (#14). 0-0-0 provisionally preferred the H's material clarity (#16), and Karl_K thought the H a little more promising cut-wise on limited video while saying this G was far from bad (#17). The G is a comparison candidate, not a proven poor-cut control; the available inventory establishes neither a certificate number nor a standalone downloadable 360.

source_links.note: Same comparison album as R12; the G is a separate physical stone.
